verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents that cards can be added to Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, and has a dedicated digital-wallets guide. However, the pack only shows these headline mentions. Nothing describes push provisioning from the developer's app, the Apple/Google entitlements process, in-wallet card art, or manual provisioning as a fallback. The card-appearance item covers physical cards only. Missing for 10: push provisioning SDK or flow details, entitlements process documentation, in-wallet card art customization, manual provisioning fallback, independent or hands-on corroboration.
